growth_signal.value: Processes nearly 1.75 million transactions a day, approaching one billion a year, with customers including Deutsche Bank, Bolt and Buckaroo, and grew headcount by more than 20% after a Series B.

raised.value: €37M Series B, after an earlier €15M round

entry.idea: Silverflow gives banks and payment providers a modern, cloud-based way to process card payments, connecting directly to card networks like Visa and Mastercard.
entry.lesson: Rebuild critical financial infrastructure from scratch as cloud-native, and large institutions will eventually switch for the speed and data benefits.
entry.name: Silverflow

growth.reason: Approaching one billion transactions a year with named major customers like Deutsche Bank is a large, well-documented scale signal.

market.reason: Card payment processing is a huge, essential market worldwide, and Silverflow already serves customers across Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific.

tech.reason: Building a direct, cloud-native connection to card networks is hard, trust-sensitive infrastructure work that takes years to replicate.

entry.twist: It replaces old, slow payment processing infrastructure with a cloud-native platform and simple APIs, instead of patching legacy systems.
entry.who_pays: Banks and payment providers pay to process card payments through Silverflow's platform.
entry.why_now: Banks and payment providers are under pressure to modernise old payment infrastructure that struggles to keep up with today's transaction volumes and data needs.
